adaptive_basis_neuron.equations: w=softmax(Wr x); h=sum_i w_i basis_i(z), bases=[relu(z)^2, z*tanh(z), relu(z)*sigmoid(1.5z)]
adaptive_basis_neuron.novelty: Token-local mixture of nonlinear bases, not a single known activation replacement.
adaptive_basis_neuron.why: A block can choose sharper, signed, or smoother responses per token without expensive routing or seq attention.

bottleneck_aware_neuron.equations: e=U silu(D norm(x)); h=relu(z+sigmoid(G norm(x)) e)^2
bottleneck_aware_neuron.novelty: Block-local low-rank basis injection aimed at the output compression bottleneck without touching the head or loss.
bottleneck_aware_neuron.why: The factorized output bottleneck rewards features already compressible into low-rank subspaces; this adds a block-local low-rank echo before FFN squaring.

channel_drop_square_neuron.equations: h=m_channel*relu(Wf norm(x))^2 where m_channel is shared over the sequence during train
channel_drop_square_neuron.novelty: Block-local sequence-shared hidden channel dropout for a causal conv-memory FFN.
channel_drop_square_neuron.why: Regularizes whole expanded channels consistently across the long sequence, targeting channel co-adaptation rather than token noise.

conv_disagreement_neuron.novelty: Uses disagreement among existing causal conv branches as a local context signal controlling neuron curvature.
conv_disagreement_neuron.why: Multi-scale branch disagreement marks uncertain local context. The neuron dampens curvature there to stabilize updates over ambiguous spans.

hidden_drop_extreme_square_neuron.equations: h=dropout(relu(Wf norm(x))^2, p=0.20 during train); y=ffn_out(h)
hidden_drop_extreme_square_neuron.novelty: Stress-test endpoint for the zero-parameter hidden regularization curve inside the conv-memory block.
hidden_drop_extreme_square_neuron.why: Bounds the useful dropout-strength range and tests whether the apparent monotonic improvement breaks under aggressive hidden regularization.

hidden_drop_high_square_neuron.equations: h=dropout(relu(Wf norm(x))^2, p=0.10 during train); y=ffn_out(h)
hidden_drop_high_square_neuron.novelty: Aggressive train-time activation thinning inside the long-context conv-memory FFN without changing inference math.
hidden_drop_high_square_neuron.why: Tests whether the hidden-drop win is robust to stronger anti-coadaptation or whether p=0.05 is near the safe edge.

hidden_drop_low_square_neuron.equations: h=dropout(relu(Wf norm(x))^2, p=0.02 during train); y=ffn_out(h)
hidden_drop_low_square_neuron.novelty: Very light train-time activation thinning on the squared-neuron FFN hidden state.
hidden_drop_low_square_neuron.why: Tests whether a lighter block-local hidden regularizer can reduce overfit while preserving the near-baseline 2048 validation level.

hidden_drop_mid_square_neuron.equations: h=dropout(relu(Wf norm(x))^2, p=0.075 during train); y=ffn_out(h)
hidden_drop_mid_square_neuron.novelty: A stronger zero-parameter train-time thinning point for the block-local squared-neuron expansion.
hidden_drop_mid_square_neuron.why: The p=0.05 version won multiple 2048-step seeds while p=0.02 was too weak at 1024, so this checks whether the regularization optimum is higher.

hidden_drop_p25_square_neuron.equations: h=dropout(relu(Wf norm(x))^2, p=0.25 during train); y=ffn_out(h)
hidden_drop_p25_square_neuron.novelty: High-strength zero-parameter hidden activation thinning for the squared-neuron conv-memory FFN.
hidden_drop_p25_square_neuron.why: The 2048 curve continued improving through p=0.20, so this probes the next stronger point before committing scale-up evidence.

hidden_drop_p30_square_neuron.equations: h=dropout(relu(Wf norm(x))^2, p=0.30 during train); y=ffn_out(h)
hidden_drop_p30_square_neuron.novelty: Upper curve endpoint for squared-neuron hidden regularization with baseline-equivalent inference math.
hidden_drop_p30_square_neuron.why: Tests whether very high train-time thinning still improves 2048-step generalization or crosses into underfitting.

hidden_drop_p35_square_neuron.equations: h=dropout(relu(Wf norm(x))^2, p=0.35 during train); y=ffn_out(h)
hidden_drop_p35_square_neuron.novelty: Very high train-time activation thinning endpoint for the squared-neuron conv-memory FFN.
hidden_drop_p35_square_neuron.why: The 2048 curve improved through p=0.30 even as 1024 weakened, so this tests whether later generalization still benefits from heavier hidden thinning.

hidden_drop_p40_square_neuron.equations: h=dropout(relu(Wf norm(x))^2, p=0.40 during train); y=ffn_out(h)
hidden_drop_p40_square_neuron.novelty: Aggressive zero-parameter hidden regularization curve endpoint with baseline-equivalent inference math.
hidden_drop_p40_square_neuron.why: Stress-tests the high-dropout regime to locate the underfitting boundary before scale-up recommendations.

hidden_drop_square_neuron.equations: h=dropout(relu(Wf norm(x))^2, p=0.05 during train); y=ffn_out(h)
hidden_drop_square_neuron.novelty: Train-time activation thinning inside the block-local squared-neuron expansion rather than adding memory-route capacity.
hidden_drop_square_neuron.why: The 2048 failures repeatedly show lower train loss but worse validation, so this regularizes the FFN hidden path without changing tokenizer, objective, or eval metric.

hidden_drop_ultra_square_neuron.equations: h=dropout(relu(Wf norm(x))^2, p=0.15 during train); y=ffn_out(h)
hidden_drop_ultra_square_neuron.novelty: Very strong train-time thinning on the squared-neuron expansion with baseline-equivalent inference math.
hidden_drop_ultra_square_neuron.why: The p=0.05, p=0.075, and p=0.10 curve improved on seed 31, so this checks whether stronger regularization is still beneficial or starts to underfit.

mem_threshold_neuron.equations: m=memory_conv(memory_down(norm(x))); z=Wf norm(x); h=(1+0.25 tanh(Wg m)) * relu(z-0.25 tanh(Wt m))^2
mem_threshold_neuron.novelty: Low-rank causal memory modulates the activation threshold/curvature inside the FFN rather than only adding a residual memory vector.
mem_threshold_neuron.why: The existing memory path is additive. This lets causal memory change the FFN decision surface at the same token, allowing long-range evidence to alter neuron thresholds without attention.

memory_energy_drop_square_neuron.novelty: Zero-parameter stochastic coupling between low-rank causal memory energy and squared-neuron hidden activation thinning.
memory_energy_drop_square_neuron.why: The long-context memory path identifies tokens with stronger causal state. This regularizes the FFN hidden expansion most where memory energy is high, targeting memory-neuron co-adaptation while keeping inference identical to baseline.

memory_square_centered_gain_neuron.novelty: Zero-mean memory gain over the baseline square neuron.
memory_square_centered_gain_neuron.why: Preserves per-channel memory routing while preventing global token-wise FFN gain shifts.

memory_square_conv_agreement_gain_neuron.novelty: Block-local conv-memory agreement directly modulates squared FFN features.
memory_square_conv_agreement_gain_neuron.why: Tests the agreement signal on the baseline squared neuron without signed phase residuals.

memory_square_gain_neuron.novelty: Causal low-rank memory multiplicatively modulates the existing squared FFN feature map.
memory_square_gain_neuron.why: Tests memory-neuron coupling without adding the signed phase residual path that produced seed-mixed overfit.

memory_square_novelty_gain_neuron.novelty: Causal memory novelty multiplicatively modulates baseline squared features.
memory_square_novelty_gain_neuron.why: Tests memory-neuron coupling through novelty gain without the signed phase residual path.

memory_square_scalar_gain_neuron.novelty: A single causal-memory gain applied to all expanded FFN channels at each token.
memory_square_scalar_gain_neuron.why: Tests whether token-wise memory confidence is enough without expensive per-channel memory routing.

memory_square_small_gain_neuron.novelty: Low-amplitude causal-memory gain over baseline squared features.
memory_square_small_gain_neuron.why: Tests whether a conservative memory gain improves validation without the stronger gate's overfit.

phase_amplitude_neuron.equations: amp=softplus(Wa u); phase=tanh(Wp u); h=amp * sign(phase)*phase^2
phase_amplitude_neuron.novelty: Signed-amplitude carrier neuron inside this conv-memory block rather than a standard gate.
phase_amplitude_neuron.why: Separating magnitude from signed carrier may preserve directional information lost by nonnegative squared ReLU features.

phase_amplitude_neutral_neuron.novelty: Signed amplitude carrier with no extra projection parameters.
phase_amplitude_neutral_neuron.why: Tests whether the phase-amplitude signal was real or just extra parameters by reusing the baseline FFN projection.

phase_amplitude_one_extra_neuron.novelty: Uses the baseline FFN projection as amplitude and adds a distinct signed phase carrier.
phase_amplitude_one_extra_neuron.why: Tests whether separate signed carrier is the key mechanism with only one added projection instead of two.

phase_amplitude_replace_neuron.novelty: Separate amplitude and signed carrier projections replace, rather than stack on top of, the squared FFN input.
phase_amplitude_replace_neuron.why: Removes the unused baseline FFN input projection from the first phase-amplitude variant while preserving separate amplitude/phase channels.

phase_residual_blend_centered_neuron.novelty: Channel-centered signed phase correction inside the block-local neuron.
phase_residual_blend_centered_neuron.why: Removes token-wise signed residual bias so the phase path reallocates channel evidence instead of shifting all FFN features.

phase_residual_blend_half_neuron.novelty: Strength ablation of the signed-phase residual correction.
phase_residual_blend_half_neuron.why: Tests whether high signed-phase mixing causes the seed instability seen in full phase replacement.

phase_residual_blend_large_neuron.novelty: Strength ablation of the signed-phase residual correction.
phase_residual_blend_large_neuron.why: Tests whether the signed-phase residual should influence the neuron more strongly.

phase_residual_blend_neuron.novelty: A conservative per-channel signed-phase residual around the baseline neuron, designed after full replacement proved seed-unstable on real text.
phase_residual_blend_neuron.why: Preserves the known-working squared neuron while allowing each channel to learn a small signed phase correction.

phase_residual_blend_normed_neuron.novelty: Token-local residual normalization around the baseline squared neuron, not an activation swap.
phase_residual_blend_normed_neuron.why: Keeps the signed phase path but prevents it from lowering train loss by growing unchecked residual scale.

phase_residual_blend_quarter_neuron.novelty: A precise residual-strength ablation after half strength showed mixed long-sequence validation behavior.
phase_residual_blend_quarter_neuron.why: Targets the 40M/1024 overfit signal by testing a fixed midpoint between large and half residual strength.

phase_residual_blend_tiny_neuron.novelty: Strength ablation of the signed-phase residual correction.
phase_residual_blend_tiny_neuron.why: Tests whether the positive residual-blend signal is best as an almost-baseline perturbation.

phase_residual_boundary_blend_neuron.novelty: A decision-boundary-local signed residual around the squared-ReLU neuron, not an activation swap.
phase_residual_boundary_blend_neuron.why: The signed residual helped short screens but overfit at longer gates; this confines it to uncertain near-threshold FFN channels.

phase_residual_boundary_centered_neuron.novelty: Channel-centered signed residual restricted to the FFN activation boundary.
phase_residual_boundary_centered_neuron.why: Combines the strongest short-screen centered residual with a boundary mask that avoids modifying high-confidence FFN activations.

phase_residual_conv_energy_gate_neuron.novelty: Uses block-local causal conv energy as a continuous phase-residual gain control.
phase_residual_conv_energy_gate_neuron.why: High conv energy marks sharp local context where the signed residual may overfit; the gate suppresses it there.

phase_residual_memory_boundary_centered_.design: Centered memory-gated boundary-local phase residual neuron
phase_residual_memory_boundary_centered_.novelty: Boundary-local, channel-centered signed residual routed by causal low-rank memory.
phase_residual_memory_boundary_centered_.why: Tests whether memory routing needs both boundary localization and channel-centering to avoid seed-specific overfit.

phase_residual_memory_boundary_gate_neur.novelty: Causal memory gates a residual that is localized by the FFN preactivation boundary.
phase_residual_memory_boundary_gate_neur.why: Keeps causal memory routing but prevents it from rewriting high-confidence expanded FFN features that drove train/val separation.

phase_residual_memory_boundary_scalar_ga.design: Scalar memory-gated boundary-local phase residual neuron
phase_residual_memory_boundary_scalar_ga.novelty: Single-channel causal memory route over decision-boundary-local signed residuals.
phase_residual_memory_boundary_scalar_ga.why: Cheap test of whether token-level memory confidence is enough when the residual is restricted to threshold-local FFN features.

phase_residual_memory_bounded_centered_g.design: Bounded centered memory-gated phase residual neuron
phase_residual_memory_bounded_centered_g.novelty: A range-limited causal-memory route over zero-mean signed residual features.
phase_residual_memory_bounded_centered_g.why: Combines bias-free centered residuals with a bounded memory gate to reduce seed-specific over-routing while preserving channel competition.

phase_residual_memory_bounded_gate_neuro.novelty: Causal memory controls a residual gate with an explicit functional floor and ceiling instead of an unconstrained sigmoid.
phase_residual_memory_bounded_gate_neuro.why: Keeps the current memory-gate lead's per-channel routing but prevents the learned gate from collapsing toward 0 or 1 on unlucky seeds.

phase_residual_memory_centered_gate_neur.novelty: Combines causal-memory residual routing with channel-centered signed phase features.
phase_residual_memory_centered_gate_neur.why: Targets the seed 13 overfit by removing the phase residual's token-wise channel bias while preserving memory routing.

phase_residual_memory_conv_agreement_neu.novelty: Agreement between the block's two non-FFN context paths controls the neuron residual.
phase_residual_memory_conv_agreement_neu.why: Lets signed phase corrections through only when local causal conv context agrees with low-rank memory context.

phase_residual_memory_conv_centered_agre.design: Centered memory-conv agreement phase residual neuron
phase_residual_memory_conv_centered_agre.novelty: Conv-memory agreement gates a channel-centered signed phase residual.
phase_residual_memory_conv_centered_agre.why: Combines the useful centered signed residual with context agreement gating to reduce unconstrained shifts.

phase_residual_memory_conv_disagreement_.design: Memory-conv disagreement damped phase residual neuron
phase_residual_memory_conv_disagreement_.novelty: Conflict between causal conv and causal memory acts as a residual suppressor.
phase_residual_memory_conv_disagreement_.why: Targets seed overfit by damping signed residuals specifically when memory and local convolution conflict.

phase_residual_memory_delta_gate_neuron.design: Causal memory-delta gated phase residual neuron
phase_residual_memory_delta_gate_neuron.novelty: A causal finite-difference memory state controls the FFN signed residual gate.
phase_residual_memory_delta_gate_neuron.why: Static memory gates may learn seed-specific biases; routing from memory changes emphasizes transitions and long-context updates.

phase_residual_memory_gate_neuron.novelty: Couples the existing causal memory state directly into the per-channel neuron residual gate.
phase_residual_memory_gate_neuron.why: Lets the causal low-rank memory decide when signed phase information helps long-context prediction.

phase_residual_memory_group_gate_neuron.novelty: Memory-conditioned channel-group residual routing inside the local neuron.
phase_residual_memory_group_gate_neuron.why: Splits the difference between cheap scalar memory gates and expensive per-channel gates.

phase_residual_memory_normed_gate_neuron.novelty: Causal-memory gating plus token-local residual RMS limiting.
phase_residual_memory_normed_gate_neuron.why: Keeps memory routing but limits residual scale to address the low-train/high-val overfit pattern.

phase_residual_memory_novelty_centered_g.design: Centered memory-novelty gated phase residual neuron
phase_residual_memory_novelty_centered_g.novelty: Memory-novelty routing over channel-centered signed phase features.
phase_residual_memory_novelty_centered_g.why: Combines the 128-step centered-residual signal with novelty-only memory routing to reduce long-run overfit.

phase_residual_memory_novelty_gate_neuro.novelty: Uses causal memory novelty as the neuron residual routing signal.
phase_residual_memory_novelty_gate_neuro.why: Targets seed-specific overfit by routing only from changes in causal memory state, not static memory bias.

phase_residual_memory_novelty_tiny_gate_.design: Tiny memory-novelty gated phase residual neuron
phase_residual_memory_novelty_tiny_gate_.why: Tests whether novelty routing should enter as a smaller perturbation after raw/tiny gates were seed mixed.

phase_residual_memory_rms_gate_neuron.novelty: Token-local normalization of the causal-memory routing logits before they enter the neuron gate.
phase_residual_memory_rms_gate_neuron.why: Targets seed 13/31 failures by making the memory gate depend on direction more than raw learned routing magnitude.

phase_residual_memory_scalar_centered_ga.design: Scalar centered memory-gated phase residual neuron
phase_residual_memory_scalar_centered_ga.novelty: Token-wise causal-memory gate over a centered signed phase correction.
phase_residual_memory_scalar_centered_ga.why: Tests a low-parameter memory-conditioned centered residual that may keep the cheap centered benefit without per-channel overfit.

phase_residual_memory_scalar_gate_neuron.novelty: Low-rank causal memory controls a token-wise residual gain with only one added gate channel.
phase_residual_memory_scalar_gate_neuron.why: Tests whether the strong memory-gate signal needs expensive per-channel routing or only a token-level causal gain.

phase_residual_memory_small_gate_neuron.novelty: Constrained causal-memory residual routing after the unconstrained memory gate proved seed-mixed.
phase_residual_memory_small_gate_neuron.why: Targets seed 13/31 overfit by reducing both initial signed residual strength and memory-gate amplitude.

phase_residual_memory_sparse_centered_ga.design: Sparse centered memory-gated phase residual neuron
phase_residual_memory_sparse_centered_ga.novelty: Coupled sparse channel competition in the memory route and centered signed residual feature.
phase_residual_memory_sparse_centered_ga.why: Tests whether both the routed residual and the route itself need zero-mean competition to keep validation gains at longer horizons.

phase_residual_memory_sparse_gate_neuron.novelty: Soft thresholded per-token channel competition inside the memory-to-neuron gate.
phase_residual_memory_sparse_gate_neuron.why: Forces memory routing to act only on above-average channel evidence instead of globally shifting the residual path.

phase_residual_memory_tiny_gate_neuron.novelty: Low-amplitude causal-memory gate over the signed phase residual.
phase_residual_memory_tiny_gate_neuron.why: Tests whether memory routing is useful only as a small perturbation around the baseline square neuron.

phase_residual_memory_zero_mean_gate_neu.novelty: Channel-centered memory routing gate inside the FFN neuron.
phase_residual_memory_zero_mean_gate_neu.why: Keeps per-channel memory routing while removing token-wise global gate shifts that may drive overfit.

rank_competition_centered_residual_neuro.novelty: Cheap zero-mean signed residual on top of a rank-competitive squared base.
rank_competition_centered_residual_neuro.why: Isolates whether the hybrid gain comes from rank competition plus centered signed residual before adding memory routing cost.

rank_competition_feather_neuron.equations: g=reshape(relu(z)); p=mean_group(g); h=relu(g-sigmoid(a)p)^2, a initialized to -3.5
rank_competition_feather_neuron.novelty: Near-zero group pressure that can still learn if useful.
rank_competition_feather_neuron.why: Tests whether only a very weak competition prior is enough to help without the longer-screen overfit seen in stronger pressure settings.

rank_competition_fixed_dust_neuron.novelty: Near-baseline fixed channel pressure as a block-local inductive-bias probe.
rank_competition_fixed_dust_neuron.why: Tests whether an almost-zero competition prior can produce a small stable validation improvement without lowering train loss too much.

rank_competition_fixed_feather_channel_d.equations: h=m_channel*fixed_feather_rank_competition(z) with sequence-shared channel mask during train
rank_competition_fixed_feather_channel_d.novelty: Fixed near-zero channel competition plus sequence-shared FFN expansion channel dropout.
rank_competition_fixed_feather_channel_d.why: Tests whether sequence-shared channel regularization is more appropriate for long-context conv-memory blocks than token-independent dropout.

rank_competition_fixed_feather_hidden_dr.novelty: Combines fixed near-zero channel competition with train-time hidden activation thinning.
rank_competition_fixed_feather_hidden_dr.why: Fixed feather was the closest 2048 miss; this adds train-time hidden regularization to reduce the remaining lower-train/worse-val gap.

rank_competition_fixed_feather_neuron.novelty: Fixed near-zero local channel competition as a non-capacity regularizing perturbation.
rank_competition_fixed_feather_neuron.why: The learned feather-pressure run nearly matched the 2048 baseline but its inhibition drifted upward; this tests the same weak prior without train-fit drift.

rank_competition_fixed_trace_neuron.novelty: Trace-level fixed group pressure inside the squared FFN neuron.
rank_competition_fixed_trace_neuron.why: Probes a weaker fixed pressure after the 2048 curve approached the baseline as inhibition decreased.

rank_competition_memory_centered_gate_ne.design: Rank-competition centered memory-gated phase residual neuron
rank_competition_memory_centered_gate_ne.novelty: Rank-competitive squared base with centered causal-memory signed residual routing.
rank_competition_memory_centered_gate_ne.why: Tests whether rank competition plus zero-mean signed residual routing can keep the robust rank win while improving memory-gate seed stability.

rank_competition_memory_factor_centered_.novelty: Low-rank memory-to-neuron gating over a rank-competitive zero-mean signed residual.
rank_competition_memory_factor_centered_.why: Approximates the full per-channel memory gate with a low-rank route to test whether the expensive map is necessary.

rank_competition_memory_gate_neuron.novelty: Combines group-wise FFN channel competition with causal-memory residual routing inside one block-local primitive.
rank_competition_memory_gate_neuron.why: Rank competition was the first cheap 1024-step 3/3 baseline winner; this tests whether it can stabilize the stronger memory-gated signed residual.

rank_competition_memory_group_centered_g.novelty: Coarse causal-memory channel routing coupled to rank competition and centered signed residuals.
rank_competition_memory_group_centered_g.why: Keeps memory-conditioned channel selectivity while avoiding the full memory-rank to FFN-width gate.

rank_competition_memory_normed_centered_.design: Normed full-memory rank-competition centered gate neuron
rank_competition_memory_normed_centered_.novelty: Coupled token-local normalization of memory route and centered signed residual inside the rank-competitive block.
rank_competition_memory_normed_centered_.why: Targets seed-specific overfit by limiting both the signed residual scale and the per-token memory-route scale.

rank_competition_memory_scalar_centered_.novelty: A single causal-memory route gates a rank-competitive zero-mean signed residual.
rank_competition_memory_scalar_centered_.why: Tests whether token-level memory confidence is enough to recover the full hybrid's gain at a fraction of the parameters.

rank_competition_memory_small_centered_g.design: Small full-memory rank-competition centered gate neuron
rank_competition_memory_small_centered_g.novelty: Conservative per-channel causal-memory routing over a rank-competitive centered signed residual.
rank_competition_memory_small_centered_g.why: Targets the seed 31 train/val split by keeping the full per-channel memory route but reducing its initial strength.

rank_competition_memory_suppressed_aux_h.design: Auxiliary-head competition-suppressed memory-routed centered residual neuron
rank_competition_memory_suppressed_aux_h.novelty: Separate low-amplitude output projection for rank-competition loser-channel memory recovery inside the conv-memory block.
rank_competition_memory_suppressed_aux_h.why: The failing variants mix signed memory residuals through the main FFN output projection; this isolates that route behind a controlled zero-init head.

rank_competition_memory_suppressed_bound.design: Bounded competition-suppressed memory-routed centered residual neuron
rank_competition_memory_suppressed_bound.novelty: Combines rank-competition loser-channel routing with a bounded signed residual to stabilize long linear-sequence training.
rank_competition_memory_suppressed_bound.why: Targets the 2048 NaN by hard-bounding the signed residual while preserving the full memory gate and suppressed-channel routing.

rank_competition_memory_suppressed_bound.design: Bounded small-gain competition-suppressed memory-routed centered residual neuron
rank_competition_memory_suppressed_bound.novelty: A double-constrained loser-channel memory recovery path for rank-competitive low-rank conv-memory blocks.
rank_competition_memory_suppressed_bound.why: Tests whether both failure controls are needed: bounded residual magnitude and smaller memory-route strength.

rank_competition_memory_suppressed_cente.novelty: Causal memory is restricted to the loser side of the rank-competition neuron.
rank_competition_memory_suppressed_cente.why: Tests whether memory should only recover information from channels suppressed by local rank competition rather than modifying winners.

rank_competition_memory_suppressed_energ.design: Energy-matched competition-suppressed memory-routed centered residual neuron
rank_competition_memory_suppressed_energ.novelty: A loser-channel causal-memory residual whose token-local RMS is tied to the rank-competitive base activation.
rank_competition_memory_suppressed_energ.why: The bounded route still diverged at 2048, so this constrains residual energy relative to the current base neuron rather than bounding values independently.

rank_competition_memory_suppressed_norme.design: RMS-limited competition-suppressed memory-routed centered residual neuron
rank_competition_memory_suppressed_norme.novelty: Rank-competition loser-channel routing with token-local residual RMS limiting.
rank_competition_memory_suppressed_norme.why: Keeps more amplitude information than tanh while preventing token-local centered residuals from dominating longer runs.

rank_competition_memory_suppressed_small.design: Small-gain competition-suppressed memory-routed centered residual neuron
rank_competition_memory_suppressed_small.novelty: A causal-memory residual explicitly limited to suppressed competition channels with conservative learnable route strength.
rank_competition_memory_suppressed_small.why: The 1024-step suppressed route was robust but blew up at 2048, so this keeps the same loser-channel route while reducing route amplitude.

rank_competition_memory_suppressed_stopg.design: Detached-mask competition-suppressed memory-routed centered residual neuron
rank_competition_memory_suppressed_stopg.novelty: Allows residual learning while making the suppression route a local selector instead of a trainable escape path.
rank_competition_memory_suppressed_stopg.why: Tests whether 2048 divergence comes from gradients gaming the competition mask rather than the signed residual value alone.

rank_competition_memory_uncertainty_cent.novelty: Rank-competition margin acts as a differentiable uncertainty mask for causal-memory residual routing.
rank_competition_memory_uncertainty_cent.why: The seed 31 failure looks like the memory route rewriting confident features; this only routes signed residuals near the competition boundary.

rank_competition_memory_within_group_cen.design: Within-group centered memory-routed rank residual neuron
rank_competition_memory_within_group_cen.novelty: Aligns signed residual centering with the rank-competition groups instead of whole-token channel centering.
rank_competition_memory_within_group_cen.why: The base competition is group-local, so centering the residual within the same groups may reduce token-wide shifts that hurt seed 31.

rank_competition_mild_centered_residual_.novelty: Zero-mean signed residual on a softer group-competition base.
rank_competition_mild_centered_residual_.why: The centered residual was the closest stable 2048 miss; this tests whether softer pressure fixes the final validation regression.

rank_competition_mild_neuron.equations: g=reshape(relu(z)); p=mean_group(g); h=relu(g-sigmoid(a)p)^2, a initialized to -0.5
rank_competition_mild_neuron.novelty: Softer learnable group inhibition as a low-cost channel competition prior.
rank_competition_mild_neuron.why: The original rank competition wins shorter gates but loses at 2048, so this lowers initial pressure without changing the comparison objective.

rank_competition_neuron.novelty: Cheap local channel inhibition before the squared nonlinearity, no top-k or sorting.
rank_competition_neuron.why: The low-rank head and memory force compression; group competition may allocate FFN expansion capacity to fewer stronger features.

rank_competition_soft_centered_residual_.novelty: Centered signed residual combined with very soft local channel competition.
rank_competition_soft_centered_residual_.why: Tests a near-baseline pressure setting with the centered residual that had the closest 2048 miss.

rank_competition_soft_neuron.equations: g=reshape(relu(z)); p=mean_group(g); h=relu(g-sigmoid(a)p)^2, a initialized to -1.5
rank_competition_soft_neuron.novelty: Very soft local channel competition before the squared neuron.
rank_competition_soft_neuron.why: Tests a near-baseline competition regime after aggressive pressure showed longer-screen overfit.

rank_competition_ultrasoft_neuron.equations: g=reshape(relu(z)); p=mean_group(g); h=relu(g-sigmoid(a)p)^2, a initialized to -2.5
rank_competition_ultrasoft_neuron.novelty: Minimal local channel competition as a learnable perturbation of the original squared neuron.
rank_competition_ultrasoft_neuron.why: The 2048 pressure curve improved as inhibition softened, so this probes the near-baseline region for a small but stable win.

stable_competition_neuron.novelty: A grouped inhibitory square neuron with local curvature normalization, still linear in sequence length.
stable_competition_neuron.why: Combines the two cheap first-pass signals: channel competition for allocation and RMS stabilization for curvature control.

stable_square_neuron.novelty: Local curvature normalization and leak around the squared neuron, not a simple activation swap.
stable_square_neuron.why: Keeps square-like sample efficiency while bounding large channel curvature and adding a small gradient path for inactive units.

stateful_threshold_neuron.novelty: Uses cumsum-derived causal preactivation state inside the neuron with no recurrent Python loop.
stateful_threshold_neuron.why: Long-context linear models need causal state. This gives every FFN neuron a parallel causal running threshold.
